clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity, Forsaken spellcasters use Filled Containment Coffers to capture erratic magical entities. A Cantation of Manifestation reveals and weakens rift spawn in the Apothecarium, so mages can seal them inside for examination.

Magical disturbances have appeared in Algernon's shop in the Apothecarium. The Forsaken mage Anastasia Hartwell has called on arcane practitioners to capture the entities behind them. Rift creatures are living magical energy and cannot be seen, so ordinary cages cannot hold them. Spellcasters reveal them with a Cantation of Manifestation, defeat them in combat, and snap prepared coffers shut around them. The sealed boxes protect their carriers from volatile magical backlashes and keep the creatures intact for magical dissection.

Living mana creatures in the Undercity pose a serious threat. Once sealed inside containment coffers, the beasts are carried to Anastasia Hartwell and the city's scholars. Forsaken mages seek to learn whether the intrusions come from natural rifts in Azeroth's magical fabric or are preliminary probes in a calculated magical assault on the kingdom.
